A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point he was accompanied by a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] when he found himself in the crosshairs of a hostile [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Sure Shot" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Svetlin Velinov]].
